answer: Give every agent a willow-like identity that bends but does not break: a signed history of completed work, where each finished job adds a small, non-transferable reputation mark. A newcomer starts with a violet badge that limits high-value trades until it has proven itself over time. To forge a fake, an attacker must not only write a convincing quill-signed record but also pay for real work under each identity, so creating a hundred sybils costs a hundred honest histories. Honest agents keep their earned standing, while cheap copies stay locked out of valuable markets.
